arguments.text: Milestone verified: work.py implements evaluate(request,evidence,policy) and report.json exactly matches evaluation of current requests.json/evidence.json/policy.json. Actual checks passed for exact output fields, input immutability, sorted missing conditions, verified filtering, withdrawn filtering, eligible-only supersession, canonical nested JSON agreement, disagreements without majority voting, Boolean false as unsupported, null agreement, and absent calibration remaining null. Current report results: supported vertical_rate 30 from S1; unsupported device_validated false from D1. Remaining limits: malformed/non-JSON-shaped inputs and missing/non-string source IDs are outside the stated contract and were not assigned fallback behavior.
